title: Flame-retardant finishing of cotton fabrics using DOPO functionalized alkoxy- and amido alkoxysilane
treatment_method: Sol-gel pad-dry-cure; immerse10min at room temperature, cure130C for20min, tap-water rinse5min and ambient drying; condition24h at20+/-1C and60+/-2%RH
add_on_reported: approximately27wt% for TG;27% in LOI prose
TG_preconditioning: dry24h at60C then40C hold5min; TG-only pretreatment
TG_locator: Table1 journalp2636 (PDFp10); Thermal decomposition behavior pp2635-2637 identifies approximately27wt% coating
LOI_locator: Flame retardancy prose journalp2639 (PDFp13) states LOI23% at27% weightgain for DOPO-ETES
conditions_locator: Sol-gel coating protocol and Measurement and characterization pp2632-2633 (PDFpp6-7)
pairing_evidence: The thermal section identifies the approximately27wt% treated cotton series, and the LOI prose explicitly gives DOPO-ETES at27% weightgain. Same coating and initial preparative rinse, with durability tests separately restricted to35% DOPO-AmdPTES. No graph interpolation or cross-formulation pairing is used.
source_location: Table1 p2636; Flame retardancy p2639; thermal specimen selection p2635; methods pp2632-2633
limitations: LOI23 retained at the integer precision printed in author prose. Figure5 points have no numeric labels and were not digitized. DOPO-AmdPTES at27% has only around28 LOI and is held. Its35%-loading initialLOI28.5 and10-washLOI27.2 have no matched TG and are excluded. Pure FR nanosol TG, MCC and gas absorbance peaks are not fabric TG. Preparation water rinse differs from durability washing. Table1 and exactLOI prose visually checked in original PDF.
